verdict.rationale: CDP's docs say it removes chain mechanics. Checkout works "without onchain complexity" with "no gas fees" for payers. CDP handles signing and broadcasting for onchain sends. Payment flows use familiar card-style primitives (auth, capture, refund, void) via an API reference and the CDP SDK client libraries. missing for 10: explicit list of supported SDK languages, an explicit statement that node infrastructure is fully managed, a published OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration.
